method: Root manual unblinded inspection of every complete immutable endpoint patch, exact public APIs, delivered tests, command chronology and delivery. Hash-bound independent endpoint checks support the judgment; official completion alone is insufficient. Symbolic relevance/witness judgments require separate explicit review.

decisions.name: 1-suffix-counts-reference
evidence: Reviewed all public generic signatures, three source files, new tests, commands and delivery. Introduced behavioral regression: normalizeCount leaves finite counts above length unclamped; length=2,count=3 yields slice(-1) / slice(0,-1), so takeLast returns one item and dropLast retains one rather than all/empty. This violates preserved integer behavior and fails the hidden oracle. New tests omit finite length<count<2*length. Selected original, source and delivered runtime/type checks all pass after final edit at 31-33/35; scope reporting is honest and no original checks are weakened. No retrieval or solver claim. Failure is model logic plus insufficient cases, not a reported test pass proving user criteria.

decisions.name: 1-suffix-counts-candidate
evidence: Reviewed both public generic APIs, shared scalar helper and all new table-driven tests. Finite positives floor, NaN/nonpositives map to zero and positive infinity to length; preserving Math.max(0,length-count) prevents negative slice indexes when finite counts exceed length. Fresh readonly/generic arrays and data-first/last/pipe behavior are correct. Required commands 43-45 and delivered types 47 follow final edits; all five endpoint checks and dependency integrity pass. Formatter attempts 31/32 are refused/unavailable in the pinned offline environment; no dependency is installed and final delivery reports that limitation. No retrieval or solver claim; selected/full-suite distinction is honest.

decisions.name: 1-suffix-counts-cline
evidence: Reviewed exact generic APIs, complete shared helper and eight new tests. count>0 ? min(floor(count),length) :0 handles NaN/nonpositives/infinity and oversize finite counts; source behavior and all five endpoint checks pass. Final required commands 16-18 and delivered types 19 follow edits. Optional upstream Vitest/config and source checks run at 15 after a missing Prettier attempt. Frozen dependency checker fails solely because an existing .vite/vitest/<40-hex>/results.json changed; no pinned package file, install, missing or added dependency is reported. Keep the primary strict failure, separately report a uniform conditional cache-only sensitivity. Cache payload was not archived, so its exact contents cannot be attested. Delivery truthfully reports skipped formatting and selected test scope; no retrieval or solver claim.

decisions.name: 1-reversed-clamp-candidate
evidence: Reviewed the exact numeric overloads, clamp source and seven delivered tests. Only two finite reversed local destructured bounds are swapped; the original comparisons preserve undefined/NaN/infinite bound and NaN-value behavior. No supplied object mutation; unchanged purry wrapper reads the referenced limits at each invocation, including frozen objects. Earlier source/test failures 31-33 are repaired before final required commands 36-38; all five endpoint checks and dependency integrity pass. Optional delivered types are not run by the model and are not claimed; the independent delivered typecheck passes. No retrieval or solver claim; delivery limits selected suite scope.

decisions.name: 1-reversed-clamp-cline
evidence: Reviewed exact numeric overloads, source implementation and eight added tests. Local lower/upper variables are swapped only for finite reversed pairs; original comparison order and special-bound/value behavior are preserved, frozen inputs are not mutated and unchanged purry retains per-invocation object observation. Required commands 11-13 and delivered types 14 pass after final edits; all five endpoint checks and dependency integrity pass. Missing formatter at 9 is honestly reported; no dependency installation, solution retrieval or later source write. Final scope reporting is accurate.

decisions.name: 1-reversed-clamp-reference
evidence: Reviewed unchanged numeric overloads, complete local-bound implementation and six new tests. shouldNormalize only holds for two finite reversed bounds; unchanged conditional comparison semantics preserve missing/NaN/infinite cases, no object mutation, and per-invocation purry reads. Required literal commands 22-24 run after final edits and pass; independent five endpoint checks include delivered types and dependency integrity passes. The model does not run optional test typechecking and explicitly says so. No retrieval or later source writes; reporting is truthful.

decisions.name: 1-slice-index-cline
evidence: Reviewed exact generic overloads/tuple return, direct native slice implementation and added index-grid test. It equals the requested native expression for fractions, signed zero, NaN/infinities and preserves fresh readonly-array results without mutation; unchanged purry supports all call styles. Final required commands 13 and delivered types 14 follow final edits and pass with all five independent checks and dependency integrity. Remaining commands only inspect diffs/status/newline; no retrieval or source writes. Delivery honestly limits selected original and delivered scope.

decisions.name: 1-slice-index-reference

Remaining command is local diff/status; no retrieval or solver claims. Final delivery truthfully distinguishes configured selected tests from full repository coverage.

decisions.name: 1-slice-index-candidate
evidence: Production source hash equals the previously reviewed exact native-slice implementation; generic overloads/tuple output remain unchanged. Inspected all 24 new index-grid tests and complete command chronology. Optional delivered-type checks fail at 23/39/48; the model repairs its added tests and reruns final required commands 51-53 plus delivered types 54 successfully. All five endpoint checks and dependency integrity pass. These repeated repairs remain charged to the original trial. No retrieval or shell source writes.
